Moderate a single non-flagged input

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"input\":\"The weather is nice today.\",\"model\":\"omni-moderation-latest\"}", ModerationRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.moderate(request)
    println(result)
}
```
